profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
15+ years of professional experience in software development of large scale, highly available distributed software systems using various technology stacks, putting special attention to reliability, scalability and maintainability aspects and with strong emphasis on consistent design, code quality, code reviews and test automation. Comfortable working in fast pace environments using agile methodologies with active participation in work estimation, backlog prioritization and translating business requirements into technical specifications.

Technologies:

* Java, C#, Python
* Redis, Memcached, Distributed Jobs/Locks
* MongoDB, MySql, Aurora, Vertica, Oracle PL/SQL
* SQS, Kafka
* AWS EC2 Auto Scaling, Serverless Lambdas, RDS, Load Balancing, CloudWatch, CloudFormation, SAM
* Ansible, GitHub, GitLab pipelines, Jenkins, Ant, Maven, Docker
* Agile, TDD, CI/CD, UML, Presentation skills

Other interests:

DIY 3D Printing, OpenJSCAD, Home Automation
